Companion monograph / Level-1 audit

Falsifying Semantic Emergence and Toroidal Spatial Resonance

A multi-track computational audit of finite affine systems, geodesic fields, genetic sequences, and frozen-model structure recovery.

20 Aug 2026Reza NirouyarPublic full text on Zenodo
Deposit identity

This PDF is publicly included inside the Zenodo software release VARZIN Level-1 Computational Stack v2.0.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22036769). No separate article DOI was verified for the monograph, so VARZIN does not present the software DOI as though it were a distinct article DOI.

01 / evidence architecture

One paper, several evidence classes.

The paper’s most useful methodological move is to separate proved finite-affine mathematics from numerical benchmarks and empirical null-model tests. Those layers should not be treated as interchangeable evidence.

Mathematics

48 affine operators

For Aff(ℤ₁₂), the unit multipliers are 1, 5, 7, and 11, giving 12 × 4 = 48 affine operators.

Construction

Mirror-13

The reported transition construction contains 312 configurations and 600 directed edges; the lazy-walk spectral gap is reported as ≈0.04133.

Audit

Null models first

Geophysical, genomic, and language-model claims are evaluated against domain-specific controls rather than promoted from mathematical structure alone.

02 / strongest results

What survived the audit.

  • The finite-affine counting result is mathematical and reproducible independently of the project’s physical or semantic interpretations.
  • The torus node-location control reports nearly the same spectral response for the named locations and random oceanic nodes, favoring a generic local-potential response rather than location-specific resonance.
  • Under an Alpide-conditioned tectonic null, the apparent Kailash seismic effect dissolves (p = 0.3956); Giza is also non-anomalous (p = 0.9550).
  • The deterministic Chromosome 11 scan reports zero significant windows after Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction under the stated dinucleotide-preserving null.
  • The frozen-model Track D audit reports near-random designed-axis recovery for the tested Mistral and Llama systems.
03 / negative results

Falsification is not a footnote.

Supported within scope

  • Finite-affine algebraic facts.
  • Construction-specific numerical results.
  • Deterministic computational workflows.
  • Null-model outcomes under the stated data and controls.

Not supported by these tests

  • Independent toroidal physical-field resonance at Giza or Kailash.
  • Anomalous linguistic/harmonic encoding in the tested chromosome window.
  • Recovery of the designed LUXVAR axes by the tested frozen models.
  • A completed human VPE-001A result.

05 / scope

Read each conclusion at the scale of its test.

The paper spans mathematics, numerical PDE work, seismology, genomics, and language-model evaluation. A negative result in one track does not prove a universal negative in the entire domain, and a proved affine theorem does not validate a physical, biological, cognitive, or semantic hypothesis.

Human-study boundary: VPE-001A is described as a planned protocol in this record. It is not a completed human outcome and should not be cited as one.
